王野终于在一个摊位上看见了野味，这是父子两人。儿子五大三粗的，父亲是个干瘦的老头。魁梧的汉子蹲在摊位前抽着旱烟，老头则坐在不远处的石头上叼着个烟袋锅子。

王野蹲下看着摊位上的野味，种类还挺多，野鸡，野兔，还有飞龙，这些东西都是风干过的。王野觉得这家人还挺聪明，现在就知道服务态度了。可是王野一问话，就后悔了，态度个屁。

王野蹲着问道：“大哥，这些野味儿怎么卖的？”

汉子抬头看了一眼就满脸耐烦：“去去去，东西不卖。”

王野被这一下整懵了：“卧槽，这踏马什么情况，老子问个价还被看不起了这是。”

王野脾气也上来了张嘴就骂道：“你踏马摆摊不卖东西，显摆你家肉多呢？”

汉子听见王野骂人，腾的一下就站起来了回骂道：“你踏马个小犊子骂谁呢？”

就在王野要继续对骂时，后面的老头过来了，对着汉子的屁股就是一脚骂道：“你个王八犊子，让你看会摊儿，你他娘的都跟几个人吵吵了。”

王野听着老头的骂声差点没笑了，这老头骂儿子也不避讳点，又是王八，又是他娘的，这不是把自己也捎上了吗？

老头把汉子推了一把，站在摊位前对着王野解释道：“小兄弟，别生气啊，我家这个王八犊子不会说话，你多担待。这也是把他问的不耐烦了。我们是想用这野味儿换点粮食，可是这一晚上全是问价儿的，一个换的都没有。”

王野一下就明白了，合着这汉子是让人折腾的够呛了。王野笑呵呵的说：“大爷，没事儿，谁还没个心情不好的时候呢。”

老头：“小伙儿敞亮，说说吧，想换什么，大爷绝对不让你吃亏。”

王野心想：“都踏马说老狐狸，老狐狸真是一点没错，这老头就看了一眼就知道王野背着的是粮食。”

王野竖了个大拇指：“大爷好眼力呀。”

老头也不客气说道：“打了一辈子猎，要是这点儿眼力都没有，那这对招子也没用了。”

王野问道：“大爷，你这东西怎么换？”

老头说道：“小兄弟敞亮，我也不跟你抠搜的，所有的肉都两斤半粗粮换一斤。”

王野心里换算了一下，真的挺合适的，人家的肉都是风干的，这就很折秤了。王野也不客气，直接说：“那大爷，你这儿有多少，您给称称吧。”

老头吃惊的看着王野说道：“小伙儿，我这儿可不老少，就你那个袋子装的可不够。”

王野说：“大爷，放心吧，我有同伴在呢，粮食绝对够，就怕你们拿不了。”

老头听了王野的话也没细问，就开始称重，除了摊位上在老头刚才坐的石头后面还有一个麻袋。分堆儿称完后老头说：“小伙儿，我这各种肉一共35斤，你得给大爷87斤半，大爷在饶你半斤，给87斤就行。”

王野把麻袋往前一放：“大爷这是30斤棒子面，你先给我15斤肉，一会儿我就过来跟您换剩下的。”

老人从中称出15斤装在一个袋子里，递给王野。拿过王野的棒子面伸进袋子底部抓出一小把，借着灯光看了看，还捏了一小点放进嘴里嚼了嚼，立刻露出喜色。

Wang Ye finally saw game at a stall. It was a father and son.The son is tall and thick, and the father is a skinny old man.The burly man squatted in front of the stall and smoked dry cigarettes, while the old man sat on a stone not far away with a cigarette pot in his mouth.

Wang Ye squatted down and looked at the game on the stall. There were quite a lot of kinds, including pheasants, hares, and flying dragons. These things had all been dried.Wang Ye feels that this family is quite smart, and now they know their service attitude.But as soon as Wang Ye asked, he regretted it and his attitude was shit.

Wang Ye squatted and asked, "Brother, how do you sell these game meats?"

The man raised his head and looked impatient: "Go, go, I won't sell anything."

Wang Ye was stunned by this: "Damn it, what's going on with this horse? I asked the price and was looked down upon."

Wang Ye's temper also increased and he opened his mouth and cursed: "You set up a stall without selling anything, so you show off how much meat you have?"

When the man heard Wang Ye scolding someone, he stood up and shouted back, "Who are you scolding like a little kid?"

Just when Wang Ye was about to continue scolding, the old man behind him came over, kicked the man on the butt and cursed: "You bastard, let me watch the stall for a while, you have already made a fucking quarrel with a few people."

Wang Ye almost stopped laughing when he heard the old man's scolding. The old man didn't shy away from scolding his son. He was a bastard and his mother. Didn't he bring himself along with him?

The old man pushed the man and stood in front of the stall and explained to Wang Ye: "Little brother, don't be angry. This bastard of mine can't speak. Please bear with me. This also made him impatient with questions. We wanted to exchange this game for some food, but all the people asked about the price this night, and we didn't get any exchange."

Wang Ye understood immediately that cooperating with this man was very frustrating.Wang Ye said with a smile: "Uncle, it's okay, who has never been in a bad mood?"

Old man: "Young man, tell me what you want to change. I will never let you suffer."

Wang Ye thought: "Everyone is talking about the old fox. The old fox is absolutely right. The old man knew at one glance that Wang Ye was carrying grain."

Wang Ye gave a thumbs up: "You have such good eyesight, sir."

The old man said unceremoniously: "I have been hunting all my life. If you don't have this bit of eyesight, then this pair of tricks will be useless."

Wang Ye asked: "Uncle, how do you change this thing?"

The old man said: "Little brother, I won't pick it up with you. All the meat will be two and a half kilograms of whole grains for one kilogram."

Wang Ye did some calculations in his mind and found that it was quite suitable. Their meat is all dried, which makes it very convenient.Wang Ye was not polite and said directly: "Uncle, how many do you have here? You can weigh them."

The old man looked at Wang Ye in surprise and said, "Young man, I don't have many young and old here, and your bag just doesn't hold enough."

Wang Ye said: "Uncle, don't worry. I have companions here. There will definitely be enough food. I'm afraid you won't be able to get it."

The old man listened to Wang Ye's words without asking any further questions and started weighing. In addition to the stall, there was a sack behind the stone where the old man was sitting just now.After weighing the meat into piles, the old man said: "Boy, I have a total of 35 kilograms of various kinds of meat. You have to give me 87 and a half kilograms. I will spare you half a kilogram, so just give me 87 kilograms."

Wang Ye put the sack forward: "Uncle, here are 30 kilograms of stick noodles. You give me 15 kilograms of meat first. I will come over and exchange the rest with you in a while."

The old man weighed out 15 kilograms and put it in a bag and handed it to Wang Ye.He took Wang Ye's stick noodles and reached into the bottom of the bag to grab a small handful. He looked at it under the light, pinched a small amount and put it in his mouth to chew, and he immediately looked happy.
